Term2: Foot ulcer in patient with diabetes
Text:
# FOOT ULCER IN PATIENT WITH DIABETES MELLITUS

Foot ulcers in patients with diabetes mellitus are colonized with bacteria. Do not treat colonization with systemic antimicrobials.

[Foot ulcers WITH infection of surrounding tissues](foot-ulcer-w-infect)
